relocatedFromActions.note: These exact files hold logic that lived under apps/*/lib/actions/** (allowlisted above) before the NO_RAW_DB_IN_ACTIONS refactor moved data access into services. Listing them by path keeps the previously accepted state without allowlisting lib/services/** as a whole.
